fields.footer.text:
Make room for everyday living.
Rama Living is a fictional furniture brand used to demonstrate Rama Studio.
fields.site.notice: Fictional showroom. Prices and products are illustrative. CC0 photographs show room inspiration, not the exact products offered.

faq.faq.items:
Can I pay here? | This fictional demonstration takes no payments.
How do I order? | Add products to a shopping list, then review the request. A real business can add its WhatsApp number in Studio tools.
Are these exact product photos? | No. These CC0 photos illustrate room ideas. Products and prices are examples.
